text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Everyone is incredibly fast, but I'm the one who ends up winning! Helios even gives me a smooch to celebrate(?) for some reason!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr also congratulates me on my win, but she's acting a little strange…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm worried about her, but right now I just want to cook up some good food in celebration with Trainer! ♪
